## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the containment check in `preview` before merge: it compares paths textually and never resolves them, so a `..` path such as `../secret.txt` passes and the function reads files outside the home directory.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under a home directory, and `settings_file`, which returns `<home>/settings.toml`. It adds tests for both and adds a one-line text file, `tests/review-note.txt`.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../secret.txt")` passes the check and reads `home/../secret.txt`, because `Path.is_relative_to` compares path parts textually without collapsing `..` or following symlinks. A symlink inside home that points elsewhere also passes. The only negative test, at `tests/test_paths.py:20`, uses an absolute path outside home and does not exercise `..` or symlinks. — Any caller that passes user-supplied relative paths lets users read arbitrary files that the process can access. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()`, and add `..` and symlink cases to `test_preview`.
